g.title: Anonymous Internet Attacker no account or prior foothold Request data reaches shell commands and SQL Send POST /vulnerabilities/api/v2/health/connectivity with JSON target containing a shell metacharacter and command. C-03 · DVWA REST API No account required Application data builds operating-system commands (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information

Anonymous Internet Attacker no account or prior foothold Unchecked user updates grant admin rights Access requires token=user_token, a constant disclosed in an HTML comment; any authenticated user can read any profile by adding it. C-03 · DVWA REST API No account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Anonymous Internet Attacker no account or prior foothold Bypass or Forge Authentication Access and refresh tokens are AES-128-GCM encrypted with the literal key 'Paintbrush', and the plaintext secrets ('12345', '98765') are also in source. An attacker with the source can craft a token with a far-future expiry that passes check_access_token and use the order API. C-03 · DVWA REST API No account required; Source-repository access required Secrets are committed to source instead of a managed store (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Authenticated Internet Attacker owns a regular account; logged in Access Exposed Data and Secrets At vulnerabilities/view_source.php:63, an authenticated user sends id and security values containing traversal sequences, for example id=sqli and security=../../../config/config.inc. The values are interpolated into file_get_contents, and the content of any readable .php file is returned highlighted in the page. This includes the configuration file holding database credentials. The appended .php suffix is the only restriction. C-03 · DVWA REST API Regular account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Authenticated Internet Attacker owns a regular account; logged in Request-chosen file evaluated as code At vulnerabilities/view_help.php:20, the id and locale GET values build a path whose file contents are passed to eval() as PHP. An authenticated user chooses which file is read because path segments are not validated. If the attacker can place PHP in a file they can write (for example an uploaded file) whose name ends in help/help.php or help.<locale>.php, that content is executed. The fixed path suffix limits the targets. The served source does not show whether such a file can be placed. C-03 · DVWA REST API Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-009) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Attacker opens the public Actions run log for a push to master. C-02 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Workflow prints all repository secrets base64-encoded to logs (W-012) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
